papers.title_en: UniForge3D: Joint 3D Reconstruction and Generation in a Shared Anchor-Guided Space
papers.authors: Wenjue Chen, Wenyue Chen, Heliang Zheng, Rongfei Jia, Yuan Liu, Meng Li
papers.evidence: 从稀疏无位姿图像联合重建与生成三维资产
papers.tldr: 稀疏且未标定的多视图图像既要求重建可见几何，也要求补全不可见区域；相机相对重建与规范空间生成之间的坐标不一致，使二者难以直接协作。UniForge3D构建跟随锚点视图方位、保持物体直立的共享空间，让重建与生成分支双向交换特征，并预测逐视图点图和完整稀疏体素结构。模型再利用点图建立像素—体素对应，为每个体素挑选信息量最高的输入视图，以其特征引导细节生成。在Toys4K和GSO上取得外观与几何方面的先进结果，提升观测细节保留与完整资产生成质量，为联合重建和生成提供统一的空间建模方案。
papers.abstract_en: Generating complete 3D assets from sparse, unposed images requires preserving observed geometry while completing unseen regions. Joint reconstruction and generation offers a way to address both goals: reconstruction recovers the geometry observed in the input images, while generation contributes learned shape priors. However, combining camera-relative reconstruction with canonical-space generation introduces a coordinate mismatch that makes direct geometric interaction more difficult. Moreover, conditioning each 3D location on all views without accounting for their relevance may mix useful geometric evidence with unrelated image content, hindering local detail recovery. We present UniForge3D, which jointly models reconstruction and generation in a shared anchor-guided space, resolving their coordinate mismatch. This space follows the anchor view's azimuth while keeping the object upright. The two branches exchange features bidirectionally to predict per-view point maps and a complete sparse voxel structure. We further condition point-map prediction on the generated structure to establish pixel-to-voxel correspondences and select the most informative input view for each voxel. Features from the selected views then guide detailed shape generation, helping preserve observed geometric details. Our method achieves state-of-the-art appearance and geometry results on Toys4K and GSO, generating complete 3D assets with improved fidelity. Project webpage: https://xishuxishu.github.io/uniforge3d-project/

papers.title_en: Thinker-WM: A Unified World Model with Shared Multimodal Representations for Embodied Intelligence
papers.authors: Thinker Team, Peng Gao, Jichao Jiao, Chen Liao, Daqin Luo, Yiming Ma, Baiyu Pan, Hailin Shi, Jiyuan Wang, Xiangming Xu, Xiongwei Zhao
papers.evidence: 统一世界模型联合生成视觉、度量深度与机器人动作
papers.tldr: 具身智能的世界模型常将视觉变化、几何结构与可执行动作分开建模，难以在同一动力学中协同预测与生成。Thinker-WM以模态专属编解码器连接共享统一动力学变换器，将RGB、米制深度和机器人动作映射至共同表征并联合演化。该模型支持联合视频动作生成、世界预测、策略推断及逆动力学等任务，并在EWMBench、WorldOlympiad和WorldArena排名第一。大规模异构数据训练与对照实验显示，共享表征包含可恢复的运动信息，动作条件、几何交互和多功能训练均带来收益，为统一具身建模提供实证。
papers.abstract_en: World models have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied AI, yet existing systems often remain fragmented in the modalities they model and the functions they support. In particular, visual dynamics, geometric structure, and executable action are commonly coupled through separate interfaces or downstream modules rather than being jointly represented and evolved within a shared dynamics model. In this work, we present Thinker-WM, a unified multimodal world model that jointly models and generates RGB, metric depth, and robot action through a shared intermediate Unified Dynamics Transformer with modality-specific encoders and decoders. The model performs multimodal unification at the representation level: appearance, geometry, and action are transformed into a common dynamic representation and jointly evolved by shared parameters, while their distinct output structures are preserved. The same parameterization supports multiple functions, including joint video-action generation, world prediction, policy inference, action-conditioned generation, video-to-action generation, and inverse dynamics. To examine whether the shared representation captures action-related information, we introduce a lightweight motion probe that shows the frozen visual representation contains recoverable motion information. Thinker-WM is trained on a heterogeneous corpus comprising approximately 20K hours of egocentric video, 10K hours of real-robot data, and 1K hours of simulation data, including approximately 4K hours of real-robot data with aligned depth supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong performance across embodied world-model evaluations. Thinker-WM ranks first on EWMBench, WorldOlympiad and WorldArena, while controlled studies further demonstrate the benefits of action conditioning, geometric interaction, and multi-function training within the shared representation.

papers.title_en: $S^3$-Nav: Structured Spatial-Semantic Decision Making for Language-Guided Robot Navigation
papers.authors: Chaemin Lee, Hae Min Cho
papers.evidence: 机器人在部分可观测环境中进行语言引导导航
papers.tldr: 在部分可观测环境中，语言引导机器人导航需边探索边完成物体或关系目标，无法预先获得完整环境表示，而过多策略输入也会增加推理负担。S³-Nav增量维护持久空间语义状态，并按任务提供容量受控的决策视图；动作执行和任务终止还须依据语义证据与当前几何观测独立验证。多环境评测显示，这种分离提升闭环导航可靠性、降低策略推理成本，为可控且可验证的导航决策提供框架。
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents $S^3$-Nav, a structured spatial-semantic decision-making framework for language-guided robot navigation under partial observability. Rather than assuming a complete environment representation in advance, $S^3$-Nav incrementally constructs persistent spatial-semantic state while exposing only a capacity-controlled, task-conditioned view to the high-level policy. This separation decouples what the robot must retain from what the policy needs to inspect, allowing decision complexity to be controlled without discarding grounded evidence required for subsequent reasoning and validation. High-level navigation outputs remain provisional and are independently grounded and validated against persistent semantic evidence and current geometric observations before physical execution or task termination. Evaluations across multiple environments and object- and relation-goal tasks demonstrate that separating persistent state, decision-facing evidence, and execution authority improves closed-loop navigation reliability while reducing policy reasoning cost.

papers.title_en: PolyMorph: Learning Locomotion Policy for Cross-Embodiment Adaptation
papers.authors: Hyunsik Oh, Seunghun Jeon, Donghoon Youm, Jungwoo Hur, Hyeongjun Kim, Jeong Hyun Lee, Moonkyu Jung, Jemin Hwangbo
papers.evidence: 面向不同身体形态机器人学习通用运动策略
papers.tldr: 腿式机器人强化学习策略通常绑定特定形态，腿数、关节配置或机械参数改变时往往需要重新设计或训练。PolyMorph将URDF解析为关节—连杆模块，结合循环编码器、图Transformer与逐关节解码器，以形态条件化方式输出动作，并用归一化奖励、自适应采样和基于URDF的PD增益初始化稳定训练。仿真覆盖双足、三足、四足及未见形态变体，真实四足平台多种配置也完成部署，单一策略无需逐机器人重训即可跨形态运动。该框架展示了统一学习与跨具身迁移的可行性，降低异构机器人适配成本。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has enabled robust locomotion for legged robots, but learned policies are typically tied to a specific robot morphology and require additional engineering when the number of legs, actuators, or mechanical properties change. We present PolyMorph, a morphology-conditioned framework that learns a single locomotion policy for heterogeneous legged robots. PolyMorph converts each robot's URDF into joint-link modules and combines a recurrent encoder, graph-based Transformer, and per-joint decoder to generate actions across variable leg counts and joint configurations. To improve training stability, PolyMorph uses morphology-normalized rewards, adaptive robot sampling, and URDF-derived PD-gain initialization. We evaluate PolyMorph in simulation across bipedal, tripedal, and quadrupedal robots, including unseen morphology variants and platforms, and deploy the policy on real quadruped platforms operated in multiple configurations. The results show that a single PolyMorph policy generalizes across diverse robot morphologies without per-robot policy retraining.

papers.title_en: AVALON: Zero-Shot Indoor Navigation with Human-Seeded Topological Memory
papers.authors: Jing Xia, Changyan Li, Yuduo Wang, Guiyin Tian, Bo Wang, Yifan Liao, Mingjun Li, Shiyan Hu
papers.evidence: 面向室内机器人导航与环境理解
papers.tldr: 室内服务机器人常需进入用户熟悉、但自身从未探索的建筑，既缺少现场地图，也无法仅凭视觉获知任务权限与环境变化。AVALON用人类提供的楼层图、地点线索和初始对齐构建分层拓扑记忆，以节点到达验证执行导航，并按任务需要结合机器人现场证据更新记忆。Unitree Go2在12.81米路口至餐厅任务中，搭配X-NavDP五次均完成，平均用时46.4秒；对比DimOS-Go2的78.5秒和4/5成功率，单用策略则五次均超时。结果显示，人类先验与机器人验证协作可支持无建图、无现场训练的零样本导航。
papers.abstract_en: Indoor service robots often enter unmapped buildings whose layouts and task constraints are already familiar to users. We address this human-familiar, robot-unseen setting with AVALON, a topological navigation framework organized around human-seeded layered spatial memory, node-verified topological execution, and task-triggered, evidence-gated human--robot memory co-updating. The robot has no prior on-site traversal or site-specific training. Deployment requires only a floor plan, place clues, and an initial topology-odometry alignment. Visual depth point-goal navigation leverages verified node arrivals to perform translational re-anchoring, without requiring a robot-constructed global SLAM map. Human--robot memory co-updating fuses complementary sources of information. Human operators specify task constraints that are unobservable via vision and report offline environmental modifications, whereas the robot provides physical-state evidence through active in-situ validation. Task relevance governs whether human-reported environmental changes undergo robot validation during the active mission. Field-collected perceptual evidence gates memory updates, maintaining an explicit separation between human-specified permissions and robot-observed traversability. Our experiments on a Unitree Go2 show that AVALON with X-NavDP completes a 12.81 m Intersection-to-Dining mission in 46.4 s (5/5) with no mapping, 40.9% less robot time than DimOS-Go2 (78.5 s, 4/5), while policy-only X-NavDP times out in all of the 5 runs. These demonstrate the superiority of the proposed topological navigation framework.

papers.title_en: Anchor3DGS: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Compact Anchor-Based Representation
papers.authors: Sheng Ye, Jiangke Lin, Fudong Wang, Yi Yuan, Zhen-Hui Dong, Yong-Jin Liu
papers.evidence: 前馈三维高斯泼溅实现多视图重建，并改进基元表示
papers.tldr: 前馈式三维高斯重建虽可一次推理生成场景，但逐像素预测使高斯数量随输入分辨率和视图数增长，还会在平坦区域产生冗余、在复杂几何处覆盖不足。Anchor3DGS依据视觉信息熵布置三维锚点，使其集中于复杂区域并保持空间覆盖。每个锚点融合多视图特征、与其他锚点交换信息，再解码为局部高斯，轻量模块进一步改善渲染。实验表明，该方法在多组基准上达到领先的新视角合成质量，同时将高斯基元数量降至约十分之一，兼顾重建效果与表示紧凑性。
papers.abstract_en: Recent feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods have enabled effective multi-view 3D reconstruction by predicting Gaussian primitives in a single forward pass. However, existing approaches predominantly adopt a pixel-aligned paradigm that predicts one Gaussian per input pixel, coupling the Gaussian count to the input resolution and number of views. This also leads to redundant primitives in textureless regions and insufficient coverage in geometrically complex areas. We present Anchor3DGS, a pose-free feed-forward 3DGS framework that replaces pixel-aligned prediction with a compact anchor-based representation. Guided by information entropy, our method places a set of 3D anchors in the scene, concentrating them in regions of higher visual complexity while maintaining broad spatial coverage. Each anchor performs occlusion-aware aggregation of multi-view image features, exchanges information with other anchors, and is decoded into a set of local Gaussians. A lightweight feature enhancement module further refines the coarse RGB output from Gaussian splatting and improves rendering fidelity. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmark datasets demonstrate that our Anchor3DGS achieves state-of-the-art novel view synthesis quality while only using an order of magnitude fewer Gaussian primitives.

papers.title_en: Cross-Embodiment Causal Transfer from Human Videos to Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Xingyu Zhang, Yingchao Li, Peizheng Guo, Jie Hu, Changwen Zheng, Wenwen Qiang
papers.evidence: 研究人类视频经验向机器人操作的跨具身迁移
papers.tldr: 机器人操作学习受真实交互数据昂贵、稀缺限制，而人类操作视频虽丰富，却因形态与控制差异不能直接作为机器人动作监督。本文提出因果束引导的子任务迁移方法，从人类视频学习操作表征，并用机器人示范将其锚定到任务语义变量。方法依据因果束筛选能支撑局部机制输出且对保留输入保持响应的上下文，再以语义信息条件化世界—动作模型，使机器人依据自身观测生成动作，无需建立人机动作对应。基准实验显示其成功率优于对应基线，为跨具身迁移提供了因果约束的知识选择路径。
papers.abstract_en: Scaling robot manipulation models requires large amounts of interaction data, yet collecting diverse real-robot experience remains costly. Human manipulation videos, in contrast, provide abundant and diverse task experience that could potentially benefit robot learning. However, differences in morphology, action spaces, and control mechanisms make human motions unsuitable as direct supervision for robot actions, raising a scientific question: what knowledge in human videos should be transferred across embodiments to robot manipulation? To address this question, we analyze subtask transfer through the lens of causal beams, focusing on which contextual conditions and interaction dependencies should be retained to support local task effects. Based on this perspective, we propose Causal-Beam-Guided Subtask Transfer (CBST). CBST learns manipulation-related representations from human videos and grounds them in task-level semantic variables using robot demonstrations. Within a predefined manipulation model, causal-beam constraints guide contextual information selection by requiring retained assignments to sustain local mechanism outputs while preserving nontrivial responsiveness to retained inputs. The selected semantic information conditions a world-action model, allowing the robot to generate actions from its own observations without requiring human-robot motion correspondence. Experiments on robot manipulation benchmarks show improvements in task success over the corresponding world-action model baselines.

papers.title_en: Anvil: Scaling Embodied Spatial Intelligence through Knowledge Recirculation
papers.authors: Weilin Ruan, Bohan Zhou, Jinghao Li, Yangkai Wei, Wenqian Li, Peiran Dong, Yingjie Xu, Leyi Wu, Haojian Huang, Binghui Xie, Han Yang, Kaiwen Zhou, Yinchuan Li, Ying-Cong Chen, James Cheng
papers.evidence: 研究面向行动的具身空间智能训练、数据生成与基准评测
papers.tldr: 具身空间智能不仅要识别场景，还需定位实体、推理空间关系并形成可用于行动的表达；然而异构监督容易混淆各阶段所需知识。Anvil以数据生成、训练和评测一体化框架应对这一问题，借助覆盖11种接地—关系—行动形式的数据飞轮、场景对齐评测及专用教师蒸馏，训练出9B学生模型。其构建580万条源可追溯记录，并通过首错路由和阶段损失归一化提升知识迁移效果。模型在七个公开基准上平均领先两种同量级基线，展示了闭环数据与定向监督的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied spatial intelligence requires more than visual recognition: models must localize entities, reason about their relations, and express this knowledge in action-relevant forms. Yet joint training can conflate the knowledge needed at different stages because supervision is fragmented across incompatible geometric and semantic outputs. We introduce Anvil, a unified framework for data generation, training, and benchmarking for embodied spatial intelligence. (1) Anvil-Gen is a heterogeneous data flywheel that combines form-specific generation, cross-stage consistency verification, and failure-driven recollection across 11 Ground--Relation--Act forms. (2) Anvil-Ben provides scene-aligned supervision for learning diverse embodied spatial capabilities and scene-linked assessments that distinguish stage competence from error propagation. (3) Anvil-MOPD is a 9B student that consolidates heterogeneous spatial knowledge through distillation from specialist teachers. Semantic-first-fault routing targets teacher supervision to the student's earliest decisive failure, while stage normalization controls the loss scale across native outputs of different lengths. We construct 5.8M source-grounded records spanning 160K images, reserving 580K spatial records for held-out evaluation and using the remaining 5.22M records for training. On average across seven public benchmarks, Anvil-MOPD outperforms Qwen3.5-9B and RynnBrain-8B by 9.29 and 11.03 percentage points, respectively, while reaching 80.67% on VABench-Point. Controlled studies support targeted coverage, selective transfer, and feedback-guided repair as complementary framework components.

papers.title_en: PhysForge: Material-Controllable 3D Reconstruction with Separable Components
papers.authors: Yuchen Wang, Yanqi Bao, Zheng Gu, Zhengqing Chen, Jieqi Shi, Jing Huo
papers.evidence: 利用材质条件动态拟合物理属性，直接关联材质特性估计
papers.tldr: 物理三维生成虽能构建外观逼真且可模拟的资产，但现有方法难以直接控制材料行为，也难从对象与语义部件的复杂交互中估计物理属性。PhysForge提出PhysFit与PhysComp：前者以材料条件视频扩散模型的动态作为拟合参照，并通过窗口拟合和幻觉强迫区分材料响应与非物理运动；后者拆分对象及语义部件，使物理参数可独立优化并灵活组合。在PhysAssets与谷歌扫描对象数据集上，该方法在常见和少见材料的CLIP及物理可控性指标上均取得最佳表现。实验与用户研究表明，它兼顾材料响应控制和部件级建模，为复杂物理三维资产提供了更灵活的重建框架。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in physical 3D generation have enabled visually faithful assets with simulatable mechanical behavior. However, existing methods provide limited control over material behavior beyond appearance-based inference and struggle to estimate physical properties from complex interactions between objects and semantic parts. Therefore, we present PhysForge, a Video Diffusion Model (VDM)-based framework for addressing these challenges, comprising two complementary modules for material-controllable physical fitting and componentlevel interaction modeling. The first, PhysFit, leverages material-conditioned VDM dynamics as references for physical-property fitting, introducing windowed fitting to focus on material-revealing interactions and Hallucinated Forcing to disentangle nonphysical motion hallucinated by the VDM from material responses. The second, PhysComp decomposes complex interactions into individual objects and semantic components, enabling their physical parameters to be optimized independently and flexibly composed for joint simulation. Experiments on PhysAssets and Google Scanned Objects demonstrate that, compared with existing methods, PhysForge provides stronger control over material-dependent physical responses while supporting component-level physical modeling for complex interactions. It achieves the best CLIP and physical controllability scores on both common and uncommon materials, with qualitative comparisons, component-level ablations, and a user study further supporting these improvements. Our project page is available at https://masterwanna.github.io/PhysForge.html .

papers.title_en: Remembering What Matters for Long-Horizon Robotic World Models
papers.authors: Hao Wu, Tianyu Shao, Shengju Qian, Yizhou Zhao, Fan Zhang, Penghao Zhao, Weiyan Wang, Yufei Huang, Fan Xu, Kun Wang, Xin Wang, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Yuxuan Liang
papers.evidence: 改进长时程机器人世界模型的未来预测
papers.tldr: 离散视觉词元驱动的自回归机器人视频模型，长时滚动预测仍不可靠，完整保留生成历史也未必有益；场景锚点、近期状态与陈旧历史可能争夺注意力。ReCAP 在推理时保留初始场景和最近连续的完整视觉—动作块，淘汰较旧历史，不增加模块或更新参数。它在四个基准上提升视觉保真、动作一致性和机器人结构保持；BridgeV2 的 LPIPS 降低 63.3%，H=64 时 KV 占用与中位延迟分别降低 73.3% 和 6.51%。结果表明，推理时上下文调度可改善长时域预测并提升效率；记忆角色冲突解释仍未与上下文长度等因素区分。
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive robot video world models based on discrete visual tokens remain unreliable over long rollout horizons. Retaining the entire generated history does not necessarily improve prediction quality. We investigate a possible memory-role conflict in Full Context decoding: persistent scene information, recent visual-action states, and stale generated history compete for attention despite their different predictive roles. This perspective motivates ReCAP (Receding Context with Anchor Preservation), a training-free context-scheduling method for long-horizon robot video world models. ReCAP keeps the pretrained tokenizer, world model, and visual decoder frozen. It preserves the initial scene anchor and a contiguous window of recent complete visual-action blocks while evicting older generated history. The schedule preserves within-block structure and temporal order, requires no additional modules or parameter updates, and bounds active-context growth independently of rollout length. We evaluate ReCAP on RT-1, BridgeV2, LIBERO-90, and CALVIN using frozen autoregressive world models. Across evaluated environments and horizons, ReCAP improves visual fidelity, action-conditioned consistency, and robot structure preservation relative to Full Context. On BridgeV2, it reduces LPIPS by 63.3%. In the system benchmark at H=64, it reduces the logical KV footprint by 73.3% and p50 latency by 6.51%. Attention analyses show increased attention to retained recent states, while history interventions associate larger amounts of stale context with higher prediction error. These observations are consistent with the memory-role-conflict hypothesis, although they do not isolate it from context-length and position-handling effects. Our results support inference-time context scheduling as a practical approach to improving long-horizon robot video prediction and computational efficiency without retraining.

papers.title_en: Align-VAE: Aligning Attention and Geometry in VecSet VAEs for 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Huaizhi Qu, Mingxin Yang, Xintong Han, Fangneng Zhan, Chunchao Guo
papers.evidence: 改进基于潜在令牌的三维形状重建
papers.tldr: VecSet VAE以紧凑潜在令牌表示三维形状，但令牌检索与几何结构未必一致，存在全局注意力汇聚、周期性响应及法线信息不匹配等问题。Align-VAE通过共享解码器令牌、距离偏置注意力、协调编码器与解码器的法线信息，并加入受屏蔽泊松方法启发的正则项，改善几何对齐。在ABO数据集上，其倒角距离较标准VecSet VAE降低26.6%。该方法不增加每个形状的编码规模，为更可靠的三维重建提供了对齐方案。
papers.abstract_en: Set-based variational autoencoders (VecSet VAEs) represent 3D shapes as compact sets of latent tokens. Although each token originates from a query at a sampled surface location, whether these latents truly align with geometry remains unclear. We investigate this alignment and identify four issues: (i) attention-sink-like tokens that attract queries from across the shape; (ii) spatially periodic repetitions in decoder attention responses; (iii) mismatched normal information in encoder and decoder query features; and (iv) missing supervision of the intrinsic relation between signed distance fields and surface normals. To address these issues, we introduce Align-VAE with four corresponding modifications: (i) a shared bank of learnable decoder tokens provides a workspace for global computation; (ii) distance-biased cross-attention guides retrieval toward nearby predicted spatial anchors; (iii) normal-free encoder queries align the two stages' access to normal information while retaining normals in the encoder keys and values; and (iv) a screened Poisson-inspired regularizer supervises surface values and normal-direction derivatives. These changes align latent retrieval and field prediction with geometry without enlarging the per-shape code. On the ABO dataset, Align-VAE reduces Chamfer distance by 26.6% compared to the standard VecSet VAE.

papers.title_en: GeoBridge: Evolving Transferable Decoder Topologies for Geometric Vision
papers.authors: Rui Wang, Haoyu Zhang, Ran Cheng
papers.evidence: 面向深度估计与高斯重建的可迁移几何视觉解码器设计
papers.tldr: 深度估计与高斯重建都需要多尺度特征处理，但预测接口和训练目标不同；仅搜索基础模块配置，仍无法改变解码器内部变换的组织方式。GeoBridge将残差、串行和并行组合纳入阶段内拓扑搜索，同时保持固定多尺度骨架的接口。它通过函数树编码、阶段感知交叉和层级变异生成候选，以梯度敏感度对齐代理和计算、参数成本进行多目标筛选，单次搜索约需12个GPU小时。A3在NYU Depth V2与KITTI上优于四个适配基线，并在RealEstate10K高斯新视角合成取得27.11分贝；结果支持拓扑跨任务复用。
papers.abstract_en: Depth estimation and Gaussian reconstruction share a need for multi-scale feature processing, yet use different prediction interfaces and training objectives. Whether a decoder's internal computation can be optimized once and reused across these systems remains a structural design question. Search over primitive configurations alone leaves the organization of transformations fixed. To address this gap, we propose GeoBridge, an evolutionary framework for transferable decoder topologies. First, GeoBridge makes stage-internal topology searchable through residual, sequential, and parallel composition of configurable primitives. Shape-preserving composition retains the stage interfaces of a fixed multi-scale scaffold. Second, a functional-tree encoding supports stage-aware crossover and hierarchical mutation, while a gradient sensitivity-alignment proxy evaluates candidates without training. Multi-objective evolution balances this proxy with computation and parameter cost. Third, selected topologies are instantiated and trained in target systems with task-specific prediction interfaces. A single source search takes approximately 12 GPU hours. GeoBridgeNet-A3 achieves the best depth accuracy among four adapted decoder baselines under a common encoder and training protocol on NYU Depth V2 and KITTI. The same topology reaches 27.11 dB PSNR in Gaussian novel-view synthesis on RealEstate10K, and its refined representations support open-vocabulary segmentation on LERF. These results support decoder topology as a reusable design object across the evaluated geometric vision systems. Code and pretrained weights are available at https://github.com/EMI-Group/GeoBridge-NAS.

papers.title_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Fine-grained Urban Scene Reconstruction via Semantic-guided Density Control and Loss Design
papers.authors: Yueling Liao, San Jiang, Xing Zhang, Zhongwen Hu
papers.evidence: 利用语义分割引导三维高斯的精细场景重建
papers.tldr: 城市复杂场景中的细粒度结构（如线性构件与物体边界）常因3DGS密度控制粗糙、损失函数缺少语义约束而重建模糊或产生伪影。本文提出SG-GS，利用SAM语义分割指导高斯密度分配，并通过边界增强致密化聚焦结构关键区域。方法还设计多特征引导损失，以分阶段渐进训练逐步加入细粒度监督。三个数据集实验显示，相比原始3DGS，PSNR提升约2.7%至5.2%，线状结构伪影和边界模糊得到缓解，为城市精细三维重建提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has been becoming a promising 3D reconstruction technique because of its advantage of high-fidelity rendering effect with high efficiency. However, it still suffers from coarse density control and semantically blind loss functions when reconstructing the fine-grained structures in complex urban scenes. Thus, this study proposes SG-GS, a semantic-guided 3DGS method for fine-grained structure reconstruction. It takes the semantic segmentation deduced by the Segment Anything Model (SAM) as a constraint and systematically integrates it into both Gaussian density control and loss function design. On the one hand, a semantic-constrained adaptive density control mechanism is constructed, which dynamically allocates gradient thresholds to different semantic regions of the scene and introduces an additional boundary-enhanced densification strategy, so that new Gaussians are directed to structurally critical regions. On the other hand, a multi-feature guided loss function is designed, and fine-grained supervision signals are gradually introduced through a phased progressive training strategy, alleviating the artifacts caused by the lack of semantic constraints in the basic loss. Experiments on three datasets show that the proposed method consistently improves reconstruction accuracy. Compared with the original 3DGS, the PSNR increases by approximately 2.7% to 5.2%, while artifacts on linear structures and boundary blurring are effectively mitigated. The method can serve the fine-grained 3D reconstruction of urban scenes.

papers.title_en: The Midas Touch for Metric Depth: Interpretable Metricization for Generalizable Depth Perception
papers.authors: Mengtan Zhang, Yu Ma, Shiqi Jiang, Yi Feng, Wei Ye, Xieyuanli Chen, Hanli Wang, Qijun Chen, Rui Fan
papers.evidence: 将单目相对深度转换为度量深度
papers.tldr: 单目相对深度基础模型虽具备更强泛化能力，但尺度歧义及局部尺度不一致，仍使其难以直接用于度量深度感知。MTDv2将显式度量化与数据驱动细化结合，先分段仿射恢复空间变化的尺度，再沿几何变化较小的路径传播观测，并学习可解释的多路径细化。在16个公开数据集上的实验显示，该方法适应不同稀疏观测来源和深度估计范式，并支持多类下游三维感知任务。其贡献在于兼顾几何先验、可解释性与泛化能力，提升稀疏观测下度量深度恢复的稳健性。
papers.abstract_en: Recent foundation models have drastically improved the generalization of monocular relative depth estimation, yet recovering accurate metric depth from their estimates for depth perception tasks remains challenging due to scale ambiguity and local metric-scale inconsistency. Existing approaches recover metric depth from sparse observations using either explicit global affine transformation algorithms or implicit data-driven depth completion networks. The former cannot accommodate spatially varying relative-to-metric relationships, while the latter are sensitive to the distribution of sparse observations and may not fully exploit generalizable relative depth priors. To simultaneously address these issues, this study extends our previous work MTD and proposes MTDv2, a hybrid metric depth perception framework that combines explicit depth metricization with data-driven metric depth refinement. The explicit depth metricization process performs segment-wise affine transformations to recover spatially varying metric scales while preserving the geometric structure of relative depth, followed by pixel-wise depth refinement that propagates metric observations along paths with minimal accumulated geometric variation. The data-driven depth refinement process subsequently extends the explicit single-path depth propagation to a learnable multi-path formulation while preserving its interpretability. Extensive experiments conducted on 16 public datasets demonstrate the robust and generalizable depth scale recovery capability of MTDv2 across diverse sources of sparse observations and different depth estimation paradigms, as well as its broad applicability to downstream 3D perception tasks. Code will be publicly available at https://mias.group/MTD upon publication.

papers.title_en: RoTA-Bench: Evaluating 3D Spatial Reasoning through Interactive Projection Alignment
papers.authors: Qingchuan Ma, Yuexiao Ma, Xiang Meng, Yixuan Zou, Tianyu Xie, Wang Chen, Yuhui Zeng, Yuhang Wu, Xiawu Zheng, Rongrong Ji
papers.evidence: 通过连续观察与旋转动作评估模型的三维理解和行动能力
papers.tldr: 视觉语言模型要把二维观察转化为精确三维动作，必须推断几何、预测旋转影响，并利用反馈逐步修正。RoTA-Bench通过交互式投影对齐评测这一能力：模型观察旋转物体，连续选择旋转，使其投影轮廓接近目标。基准由二维图标自动构造三维物体，借助可逆初始化确保任务可解，共含674项任务及100项分层测试。实验中GPT-5.6-Sol成功率仅17%，人类参与者四轮完成测试集；模型也更常以姿态对齐变差换取轮廓改善，移除交互历史则损害精细控制。该基准显示，精确三维控制远超单纯图像识别与匹配。
papers.abstract_en: Can vision-language models turn 2D observations into 3D understanding that supports precise action? This requires inferring object geometry, anticipating the effects of rotation, and refining actions through visual feedback. We introduce RoTA-Bench to evaluate these abilities through interactive 3D-to-2D projection alignment. Given a target silhouette, a model observes a rotated object and chooses successive rotations to recover the target projection within a limited action budget. Our automated pipeline constructs silhouette-preserving 3D objects from 2D icons and uses reversible initialization to guarantee solvability, yielding 674 tasks and a stratified 100-task test set. Empirically, we find that (i) a substantial human-model gap persists: GPT-5.6-Sol succeeds on only 17% of tasks, whereas 20 undergraduate participants collectively complete the test set four times with a 100% success rate; (ii) image-space and pose-space progress can diverge: at matched states, the model more often improves silhouette overlap while worsening pose alignment than humans (19.4% vs. 10.9%); and (iii) fine-grained control is sensitive to interaction history: removing it leaves 96.8% of the model's actions at a coarse 30-degree step size and sharply reduces observed task success. These findings highlight the challenge of converting visual evidence into precise 3D control, beyond recognizing or matching individual images.

papers.title_en: Complexity-Calibrated Reconstruction Discrepancy for No-Reference Point Cloud Quality Assessment
papers.authors: Haocheng Wu, Xiangjie Sui, Xin Sun
papers.evidence: 以连续表面重建差异辅助点云质量评估
papers.tldr: 无参考点云质量评估缺少原始参考，重建差异又会同时受到结构复杂度和信号退化影响，难以直接反映失真程度。本文通过连续重建估计复杂度诱发的差异，并据此校准输入与重建之间的差异；同时比较三维几何块及对齐二维区域，融合冻结预训练感知表征得到最终评分。实验显示，该方法在三个公开数据库上稳定优于多数通用基线，表现可比若干全参考指标。其无需针对点云质量评估训练或微调，为复杂内容下的无参考质量判断提供了实用思路。
papers.abstract_en: The discrepancy induced by surface reconstruction in a distorted point cloud is jointly influenced by its intrinsic structural complexity and signal degradation. This observation motivates a referencefree point cloud quality assessment (PCQA) strategy that estimates and compensates for the complexity-induced component. We implement this strategy through successive reconstruction. Specifically, reconstructing the distorted point cloud produces an input-toreconstruction discrepancy that combines the effects of signal degradation and content complexity. Reapplying the reconstruction operator with stronger smoothing produces a discrepancy between successive reconstructions, which serves as a proxy for the complexityinduced component. This proxy is then used to calibrate the inputto-reconstruction discrepancy. We apply the same strategy to 3D geometry patches and their aligned 2D regions, enabling local comparison of the resulting discrepancies. The calibrated geometric and projected-view discrepancies are then fused into a final degradation score. For both branches, the discrepancies are measured using frozen pretrained perceptual representations. Our method does not require PCQA-specific training or fine-tuning. Experiments on three public databases show that the proposed method consistently outperforms most generic baselines and achieves performance comparable to several full-reference metrics.The code is available at https://github.com/HC-W-whc/CCRD-NR-PCQA.git.

papers.title_en: NovaSplat: Model-Free 6D Object Pose Estimation via 3D Gaussian Splatting Onboarding and Refinement
papers.authors: Georgios Floros, Evangelos Sartinas, Orestis Vangelis, Maria Pateraki
papers.evidence: 使用三维高斯模型进行对象到相机的几何位姿估计与优化
papers.tldr: 无CAD模型的新物体位姿估计，需要在首次使用时从观测数据构建物体表示，长期以来性能落后于依赖模型的方法。NovaSplat从一段短手机视频训练3D高斯泼溅模型，用于生成模板、检测与粗位姿估计，并以光度和几何损失进行可微精化。连续旋转参数化避免梯度奇异，使优化更稳定；轻量版推理速度提升3.1倍，精度损失可忽略。在家居基准上超过所有模型依赖方法，在困难工业基准上领先模型无关方法，推动无模型位姿估计接近实用水平。
papers.abstract_en: 6D pose estimation of novel objects without CAD models remains an open challenge: model-free methods must build the object representation from scratch during onboarding and have long trailed their model-based counterparts. We present NovaSplat, a model-free pipeline that closes this gap. From a short smartphone video captured at onboarding, we train a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) model that serves both as a template source for detection and coarse pose estimation and as a differentiable backbone for pose refinement. Our refiner optimizes the object-to-camera pose with combined photometric and geometric losses under a continuous rotation parametrization free of gradient singularities. On a household-object benchmark, NovaSplat surpasses all model-based methods. On a challenging industrial benchmark with textureless and specular surfaces, it outperforms all model-free competitors while substantially narrowing the gap to model-based ones. We further introduce NovaSplat-Lite, an inference variant that is $3.1\times$ faster at negligible accuracy cost. Code will be made available at \href{https://github.com/POSE-Lab/novasplat}{https://github.com/POSE-Lab/novasplat}.

papers.title_en: A Hybrid and Hierarchical Ray Tracing Method for Efficient 3D Gaussian Rendering
papers.authors: Tiancheng Zhao, Sixu Li, Yuzhou Chen, Hengyu Ding, Zhiming Pan, Chaojian Li
papers.evidence: 改进三维高斯重建场景的渲染与射线追踪效率
papers.tldr: 三维高斯泼溅通常依赖光栅化；光线追踪可支持二次光照、畸变相机与景深，但受空间分布不均、邻近射线重复遍历以及高斯和三角形求交差异影响。H2-Ray提出混合层次架构，以密度感知空间划分均衡局部遍历负载，并复用射线簇的路径状态、共享两类图元的求交硬件。八个场景中，相较RaySplats几何平均加速3.77倍，最高达9.26倍。结果表明，层次划分、路径复用与统一求交可协同提升三维高斯光线追踪效率。
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is a powerful representation for real-time neural reconstruction and rendering. While existing 3DGS systems rely on rasterization for efficiency, recent work explores ray tracing to enable secondary lighting, highly distorted cameras, and depth-of-field effects. However, compared with rasterization, ray-traced 3DGS introduces three major challenges: (1) the highly non-uniform spatial distribution of massive numbers of Gaussian primitives creates severe load imbalance; (2) neighboring pixels often generate rays with highly similar traversal paths, leading to substantial redundant traversal overhead; and (3) supporting both Gaussian and triangle primitives yields heterogeneous intersection workloads that are not well matched to existing GPU architectures. We present H2-Ray, a hybrid and hierarchical ray tracing architecture for efficient 3D Gaussian rendering. H2-Ray introduces three techniques. Load-Balanced Spatial BVH (LB-SBVH) partitions the scene into uniform grids and uses density-aware representations to convert an imbalanced global workload into balanced local traversal units. Ray-Cluster Path Reuse (RCPR) lets a proxy ray share traversal state with neighboring rays to amortize redundant traversal. The Unified Intersection Engine (UIE) supports mixed Gaussian and triangle intersections through a mode-multiplexed datapath that shares 40% of its floating-point units across both primitive types. Across 8 scenes, H2-Ray achieves a geometric-mean speedup of 3.77x and a maximum speedup of 9.26x over RaySplats on the NVIDIA RTX A5000, combining a cycle-accurate model of the modified RT Core with measured CUDA timings.

papers.title_en: SplatQ: Interaction-Aware Pruning of 3D Gaussian Splatting via Quadratic Selection
papers.authors: Hongbin Ye, Haixu Liu, Shenwei Kang, Wenxiu Wei, Tinglan Wang, Hongdong Zhu, Fan Tang, Qi Gao, Yin Ma, Kai Wen, Hai Wei, Nuo Qian, Wei-Shi Zheng, Shaobo Chen, Fa-Ting Hong, Jingke Meng
papers.evidence: 通过区域预算和联合选择优化三维高斯重建
papers.tldr: 现有三维高斯泼溅剪枝通常依据独立重要性分数全局排序，缺少区域预算控制，也未考虑同时删除多个高斯的联合影响，因而难以保证场景各处质量均衡。SplatQ将高斯按空间邻近与外观相似性分块，平滑各块保留配额，并以像素颜色对不透明度变化的响应估计单体和成对删除影响。研究将这些因素纳入二次无约束二元优化，在固定预算下联合选择高斯，并可用模拟退火或相干伊辛机求解。在五个基准上，该方法提升综合重建质量、空间均衡性与渲染速度，表明区域预算和交互建模能改善定额剪枝。
papers.abstract_en: Existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pruning methods primarily rely on global Top-K selection based on independent importance scores, lacking regional budget control and ignoring joint deletion effects. Consequently, they cannot ensure balanced reconstruction quality across a scene. We propose SplatQ, a combinatorial pruning algorithm that coordinates regional budget allocation and joint Gaussian selection under a fixed budget. SplatQ partitions Gaussians by spatial proximity and appearance similarity into size-limited blocks, decomposing global selection into subproblems of a specific size. It then smooths importance-based block retention quotas to prevent excessive budget concentration. Finally, it constructs a quadratic approximation of joint deletion effects using the responses of representative pixel colors to changes in Gaussian opacity. Individual responses, pairwise interactions, and quota penalties are incorporated into a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) objective, solved using simulated annealing (SA) or a coherent Ising machine (CIM) to jointly select Gaussians. Experiments on 5 benchmarks demonstrate that SplatQ outperforms state-of-the-art pruning methods in aggregate reconstruction quality, spatial quality balance, and rendering speed. Ablations confirm that budget smoothing improves local detail reconstruction, while interaction modeling improves Gaussian selection quality under a fixed budget.

papers.title_en: GNFormer: Gaussian Neural Field Transformer for Efficient Camera-based Occupancy Prediction
papers.authors: Guangcheng Chen, Li He, Hong Zhang
papers.evidence: Transformer用于相机占用预测与几何语义场景理解
papers.tldr: 相机占用预测为机器人感知提供场景几何与语义信息，但稀疏高斯方法仍存在基元利用率低、难以表达复杂形状的问题。GNFormer提出高斯神经场，由高斯确定空间支持并提供特征，再由神经网络解码语义占用，以增强表达能力。该方法在Occ-ScanNet、SSCBench-KITTI-360和nuScenes-SurroundOcc上取得对比单帧方法最高的IoU与mIoU，并实现最快推理。它仅用256个室内高斯、1024个室外高斯表示场景，体现出精度、速度与表示紧凑性的优势。
papers.abstract_en: Camera-based occupancy prediction provides geometric and semantic scene understanding for robot perception and has been adopted in autonomous vehicle and UAV perception systems. Gaussian primitives offer a promising alternative by potentially representing only occupied regions, thereby concentrating computation and representational capacity where needed and reducing wasted computation and memory in empty space. However, existing Gaussian-based methods suffer from poor primitive utilization, as ineffective training objectives leave some Gaussians in empty space, while the limited expressiveness of Gaussian functions restricts their ability to model complex shapes. To address these limitations, we propose a novel 3D representation, Gaussian Neural Field (GNF), which can accurately map voxel positions to semantic occupancies. In GNF, Gaussians and a neural network jointly parameterize the field, where the Gaussians define its spatial support and provide features for neural decoding, while the neural network enables more expressive occupancy modeling than Gaussian functions alone. We further develop the Gaussian Neural Field Transformer (GNFormer), a streamlined and flexible method that predicts GNFs for camera-based occupancy prediction. Across Occ-ScanNet, SSCBench-KITTI-360, and nuScenes-SurroundOcc benchmarks, GNFormer achieves the highest IoU and mIoU and the fastest inference among the compared single-frame methods. In the experiments, GNFormer can represent indoor and outdoor scenes with only 256 and 1024 Gaussians, respectively, substantially fewer primitives than prior Gaussian-based methods. The code will be released.

papers.title_en: GeoGR: Spatial-Semantic Token Compression and Group Routing for Efficient 3D VLMs
papers.authors: Yongxin Zheng, Hao Wu, Fang Li, Hu Fu, Peiran Yin, Xudong Wang, Haozhe Hu, Xinghao Chen, Yunpu Ma, Wei Zhang, Xiaoyu Shen
papers.evidence: 利用跨视角三维场景表征支持多视角场景理解
papers.tldr: 多视角表示让预训练视觉语言模型能够理解三维场景，但跨视角重复观测与逐层处理全部视觉令牌，使推理成本高昂。GeoGR提出两阶段压缩：GeoSemZip将观测合并为三维体素令牌，结合语义显著性和空间覆盖筛选，并用上下文锚点保留未选信息；GroupRoute按相关性分组跳过部分层，在后续锚点层恢复令牌。仅用原训练池30%的67K样本后训练，模型仍保留稠密模型95.2%和96.8%的性能，预填充分别加速6.8倍和6.1倍。该方法在有无显式三维编码的模型上均有效，展现了有竞争力的性能与效率权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view representations enable pretrained image and video vision-language models to understand 3D scenes, but their long visual token sequences make inference costly. Redundancy arises both from repeated observations of the same scene regions across views and from processing all visual tokens at every LLM layer, regardless of their relevance to the current computation. We propose GeoGR, a two-stage framework that jointly compresses scene representations and visual computation. At the projector level, GeoSemZip consolidates cross-view observations into 3D voxel tokens and combines semantic saliency with spatial coverage to construct a compact scene representation. Unselected voxel features are aggregated into contextual anchors to retain scene information that would otherwise be discarded. At the LLM level, we identify an effective visual computation window and observe that query-conditioned token relevance remains locally stable but changes over longer layer intervals. Guided by these findings, GroupRoute combines late entry and early exit with recoverable group-wise skipping. Low-relevance tokens bypass complete LLM layers while retaining their hidden states and can rejoin the active group at subsequent anchor layers selected under a computation budget. For compression-aware post-training, we construct a compact dataset of 67K samples by retaining 30% of the original training pool. With this protocol, GeoGR retains 95.2% and 96.8% of the dense post-trained models' performance on LLaVA-OneVision-7B and Video-3D LLM-7B, respectively, while accelerating LLM prefill by $6.8\times$ and $6.1\times$. These results demonstrate the consistent effectiveness of GeoGR across 3D VLMs with and without explicit 3D spatial encoding, highlighting a favorable performance-efficiency trade-off. The code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/GeoGR.

papers.title_en: GLIMPSE: Global-Local Indexing with Multi-Precision Spectral Encoding for Explorable Video World Models
papers.authors: Zhufeng Xu, Henglei Lv, Bailin Deng, Yikang Ding, Xiaoqiang Liu, Guoxin Zhang, Hongbo Fu, Lin Gao
papers.evidence: 针对视频世界模型中的深度与位姿误差设计全局局部记忆
papers.tldr: 可探索视频世界模型需要在镜头返回旧场景时保持一致，但将历史特征重投影到目标帧会把深度与位姿误差放大为重影或重复结构。GLIMPSE采用全局—局部记忆接口，以分频多精度坐标和几何条件频谱衰减，降低对不准确投影地址的敏感性，并在固定局部读取预算下按足迹检索历史图块。局部记忆提供视角相关外观，循环全局记忆补充场景上下文。在匹配检索与读取预算下，该方法提升几何对应和光度一致性，为可探索视频生成提供更可靠的记忆机制。
papers.abstract_en: A camera-controlled video world model must keep a scene consistent when the camera returns to it. Memories that render stored features into the target frame can turn depth and pose errors into ghosting or duplicated structure. Positional transport avoids that resampling by relocating a historical patch's address rather than its content, but assigns full positional precision even to inaccurate projections. We present GLIMPSE, a global-local memory interface with band-wise multi-precision coordinates and geometry-conditioned spectral attenuation to reduce sensitivity to inaccurate projected addresses. Local patch memory supplies view-specific appearance, while recurrent global memory provides scene context. Footprint-guided retrieval selects historical patches under a fixed local read budget. Under matched retrieval and read budgets, GLIMPSE improves geometric correspondence and photometric consistency over deterministic positional transport.

papers.title_en: Uncertainty-Aware Cortical Surface Reconstruction and Spherical Registration for Heterogeneous Brain MRI
papers.authors: Jesper Duemose Nielsen, Karthik Gopinath, Andrew Hoopes, Adrian Dalca, Axel Thielscher, Juan Eugenio Iglesias, Oula Puonti
papers.evidence: 重建并注册大脑皮层表面
papers.tldr: 皮层表面分析可描述大脑皮层的复杂褶皱，但现有深度学习方法主要适用于 1 毫米等体素 T1 加权扫描，限制了其在临床异质 MRI 中的应用。本文提出仅用合成扫描训练的网络，通过随机改变对比度和分辨率，预测皮层表面、顶点级不确定性及到 fsaverage 空间的球面配准。在标准 T1 扫描上，性能与先进方法相当；在低分辨率非 T1 扫描上优于已有同类方法，配准结果也具竞争力。不确定性可反映扫描质量并定位重建较差区域，结合快速推理，有望支持大规模临床影像分析与质量控制。
papers.abstract_en: Surface-based cortical analysis is useful in many applications as it is a natural way to model the highly folded structure of the cerebral cortex, allowing quantities such as curvature and thickness to be easily calculated. Existing deep learning (DL) methods have focused on 1x1x1 mm3 T1-weighted (T1w) scans, thus replicating classical pipelines. Here we present a neural network that is trained exclusively on synthetic scans with random contrast and resolution. Consequently, it can be applied to almost any kind of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scan. In addition, our model provides vertex-wise uncertainty estimates of the predicted surface as well as a spherical registration to fsaverage space. Our model performs on par with other state-of-the-art DL methods on 1x1x1 mm3 T1w scans and outperforms the only other method capable of estimating cortical surfaces from low resolution, non-T1w scans. The predicted uncertainty, moreover, correlates with overall scan quality on low resolution scans and highlights areas of poor surface reconstruction on 1x1x1 mm3 T1w scans, suggesting that it can be used for quality control. Finally, the predicted spherical registrations prove comparable to other DL and classical registration methods. These qualities, when combined with the fast inference time, will provide the ability to analyze large, existing databases of clinical MRI scans, with the potential for finding disease-specific patterns that would otherwise be infeasible in a research setting.

papers.title_en: Towards Complementary Keypoint Detection via Mixture of Detectors
papers.authors: Xiaoyong Lu, Guobao Xiao, Dong Liang, Songlin Du
papers.evidence: 为几何视觉与稠密匹配提供自适应关键点检测
papers.tldr: 关键点检测影响稠密匹配效果，但不同检测器在场景结构和关键点预算变化时各有长处，单一检测器往往难以获得理想分布。为此，MoD将异质检测器蒸馏到统一模型，使其一次前向即可预测多种检测图，并由轻量路由器按区域和预算选择检测器。路由器依据下游匹配质量获得任务驱动奖励，从而同时考虑关键点数量与精度。在MegaDepth、ScanNet和HPatches上，MoD在多种预算下持续优于强基线，提升关键点分布与几何性能。
papers.abstract_en: Keypoint detection plays a central role in geometric vision pipelines. Existing detectors exhibit complementary strengths across different scene structures and keypoint budgets, and reliance on a single detector often results in suboptimal keypoint distributions. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{Mixture of Detectors (MoD)} for dense matching pipelines, a unified framework for complementary keypoint detection through the adaptive composition of heterogeneous detectors. MoD first distills heterogeneous detectors into a unified model, allowing diverse detection maps to be predicted efficiently within a single forward pass. Detector selection is subsequently formulated as a patch-wise, budget-conditioned decision process, in which a lightweight router assigns the most suitable detector to each local region. To avoid heuristic supervision, the router is trained with task-driven rewards derived from downstream matching quality, jointly capturing both keypoint quantity and precision. Extensive experiments on MegaDepth, ScanNet, and HPatches demonstrate that MoD consistently outperforms strong baselines across a wide range of keypoint budgets, demonstrating its effectiveness in improving keypoint distribution and downstream geometric performance.

papers.title_en: Perceptual Characterization of Scan-induced Artifacts in Dynamic 3D Meshes
papers.authors: Huong Hoang, Truong Nguyen, Pamela Cosman
papers.evidence: 研究扫描重建网格的孔洞与表面抖动感知质量
papers.tldr: 真实场景重建的动态网格常出现表面抖动和孔洞，显著影响视觉质量；但无伪影真值难以获得，伪影之间如何共同影响感知也尚不清楚。本文开展系统、受控的感知研究，并以多视图几何推导的重建不确定性模型合成孔洞。结果显示，伪影交互具有非对称性，联合影响不能简单相加，运动还会带来随时间变化的掩蔽效应。研究据此提出紧凑的无参考质量评估框架，为动态网格质量评价提供感知依据。
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic meshes reconstructed from real-world scenes often exhibit scan-induced artifacts such as surface jitter and missing geometry, which strongly impact perceived visual quality. Objective assessment remains challenging due to the absence of artifact-free ground truth and limited perceptual understanding of artifact interactions. This paper presents a systematic and controlled perceptual study of scan-induced artifacts in dynamic meshes, focusing on surface jitter and holes. To enable systematic analysis, we introduce a physically grounded artifact synthesis framework in which holes are synthesized using a reconstruction uncertainty model derived from multi-view geometry. The study reveals asymmetric cross-artifact interactions, non-additive integration, and motion-dependent temporal masking. Based on these findings, we propose a compact, perceptually grounded no-reference quality assessment framework that encodes the observed perceptual mechanisms.
